broll_rationale: Stock real footage is more realistic + trustworthy for health niche than AI generation. Free via Pexels API (200 req/hour). Also 5-10× cheaper than Veo for 5-min videos.

narrator.speed_rationale: Calm wellness pace — barely faster than natural. NOT 1.3x like shorts.

video_structure.rationale: Long-form educational health videos. Each segment is one beat (~6-10s of narration), with Pexels B-roll keyword-matched per segment for perfect sync.
